atoms.a: Ich bin zuverlässig, sodass meine Freunde und Familie auf mich zählen können.
atoms.b: I am ((++reliable lazy)), so my friends and family can count on me.

atoms.a: Entspannt zu sein spielt in meinem Leben eine große Rolle.
atoms.b: Being ((++easy-going impatient)) is a big part of my life.

atoms.a: Ich bin ein Fan von ihr, weil sie so leidenschaftlich Kunst und Musik kreiert.
atoms.b: I am a fan of her, because she is so ((++passionate disrespectful)) when it comes to creating art and music.

atoms.a: Ich bin jemand, der versucht, ambitioniert zu sein
atoms.b: I'm the kind of person who tries to be ((++ambitious selfish)).

atoms.a: Was ich an ihr schätze, ist, dass sie eine treue Freundin ist, die immer an meiner Seite steht.
atoms.b: One thing I value about her is that she is a ((++loyal nosy)) friend, who always stands by my side.

atoms.a: Ich hoffe, ein mutiger Mensch zu werden, der sich für andere Menschen einsetzt.
atoms.b: I'm hoping to become a ((++brave insecure)) person, who stands up for other people.

instruction.text: Ordne die Begriffe ihrer Übersetzung zu.
Jackson berichtet von seiner Klasse. Lies den Text und entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: “I am in a class full of unique individuals. Everyone is so different from each other, and I love that. My classmates don't try to fit in or be like everyone else. They are just authentic and incredibly multilayered, which makes conversations with them very interesting. We celebrate our differences. And by doing so, we feel like we belong here.”

atoms.a: Jackson hates that everyone in his class is so different from each other.
His classmates are authentic and multilayered, which is why their conversations are so boring.
He feels a sense of belonging in his class.

instruction.text: Kassandra berichtet von sich. Lies den Text und wähle die korrekten Aussagen aus. Mehrere Sätze können richtig sein.

atoms.text: Sometimes people don't see me the way I see myself. They perceive me as rather pessimistic and reserved at times, but I would describe myself as honest and outgoing. So, others see me differently, especially when they don't know me well. In these cases, I need to keep in mind that only my opinion of myself is important.
